description: Defines functions for constructing various precoding weight matrices used in MIMO transmission, including single port, identity, all ports, and multiple layer/port configurations based on 3GPP specifications.

methods.name: make_single_port
methods.description: Constructs a precoder configuration for a single transmitter port.

methods.name: make_one_layer_one_port
methods.description: Constructs a precoding weight matrix for one layer mapped into one transmit port.

methods.name: make_identity
methods.description: Constructs a scaled identity precoding weight matrix for a given number of streams.

methods.name: make_one_layer_all_ports
methods.description: Constructs a precoding weight matrix for one layer mapped into all transmit ports, generating identical signals.

methods.name: make_one_layer_two_ports
methods.description: Constructs a precoding weight matrix for one layer mapped into two transmit ports based on TS38.214 Table 5.2.2.2.1-1.

methods.name: make_two_layer_two_ports
methods.description: Constructs a precoding weight matrix for two layers mapped into two transmit ports based on TS38.214 Table 5.2.2.2.1-1.

methods.name: make_one_layer_four_ports_type1_sp_mode1
methods.description: Constructs a precoding weight matrix for one layer mapped into four ports with beam and polarization selection.

methods.name: make_two_layer_four_ports_type1_sp_mode1
methods.description: Constructs a precoding weight matrix for two layers mapped into four ports with beam offset and polarization.

methods.name: make_three_layer_four_ports_type1_sp
methods.description: Constructs a precoding weight matrix for three layers mapped into four ports with specific beam and polarization configurations.

methods.name: make_four_layer_four_ports_type1_sp
methods.description: Constructs a precoding weight matrix for four layers mapped into four ports with specific beam and polarization configurations.
